Few condemned men could make a more difficult case for mercy. Seventeen years ago, Hasan, an Army psychiatrist at the time, walked into a soldier readiness center at the Texas Army post and opened fire, killing 13 people and wounding 32 others. Now, after years of appeals, the Army is preparing to execute him by firing squad. And Americans will be able to watch on live stream. That last detail has transformed what might otherwise have been the long-delayed conclusion of one of the darkest chapters in the Army's history into a more uncomfortable question: How should a nation reckon with the gravity of taking a life, even when that life belongs to a mass murderer? For Alonzo Lunsford, a former Army staff sergeant who survived being shot seven times by Hasan, the answer is complicated. items.summary_original: Americans can't seem to get on the same page when it comes to what defines socialism even though new polling shows the movement's favorability is at an all-time high. Whether far-left factions are able to rally around the label could come down to understand its principles. Fox News Digital took to the streets of a Maryland liberal hotspot, Takoma Park, for its annual street festival to talk with attendees about their definitions of socialism and how far they would be willing to go to embrace its ideals. "The fact is that there's no…one answer," Nina Gilden Seavey said when asked to define socialism. "Just the idea of like, you've been paying all these things to set up these programs and then you're actually giving them to the people," Jaw Blake said describing his view of the political movement. "It's not a special group that gets to have them, it's just available." LIBERAL HAVEN FESTIVAL-GOERS WEIGH GOVERNMENT SEIZURE OF THEIR HOMES: 'I'D BE SO GAME' Jenny Sniderman had a more direct answer, claiming that "public libraries, the police department, the fire department, all our public services, utilities," are all part of what makes up socialism. A September Gallup poll found that 43% of Americans have a positive image of socialism — the highest level since the polling organization began tracking the question in 2010. But the survey asks respondents their image of socialism without providing a definition of the ideology or asking whether they would actually support adopting it

items.summary: زلنسکی در مصاحبه تلفنی با اکسیوس تصمیم ترامپ را برای لغو یک‌جانبه تحریم‌های روسیه و اجازه دادن به این کشور برای صادرات گازوییل، «ناعادلانه و غیرصادقانه» خواند. او گفت: «این اقدام شبیه هدیه تولد برای پوتین است. واقعا افتضاح به نظر می‌رسد.»

items.summary: دونالد ترامپ، رییس‌جمهوری آمریکا، از دیوان عالی ایالات متحده خواست پرونده شکایت او علیه هیلاری کلینتون، رقیب دموکراتش در انتخابات ریاست‌جمهوری سال ۲۰۱۶ را دوباره به جریان بیندازد.

items.title: بی‌توجه به حواشی تیم ملی پرتغال، رونالدو گل شماره ۹۸۰ را هم ثبت کرد
items.summary: کریستیانو رونالدو در نخستین بازی خود پس از ترک پرحاشیه اردوی تیم ملی پرتغال، در پیروزی ۳ بر صفر النصر مقابل الدریه در لیگ حرفه‌ای عربستان سعودی گلزنی کرد. این گل شماره ۹۸۰ فوق‌ستاره بود.

items.title: «هر روز مرگ در کمین است»؛ زندگی در غزه با ادامه حملات اسرائیل
items.summary: در غزه، آتش‌بس به معنای توقف بمباران گسترده اسرائیل بود که تا حد زیادی باعث آسودگی مردم شد و ورود کمک‌های بشردوستانه و تجهیزات پزشکی به این منطقه را افزایش داد. اما اسرائیل حتی در دوران آتش‌بس نیز تقریبا هر روز به حملات خود در غزه ادامه داده است. به گفته وزارت بهداشت غزه، تنها در هفته گذشته بیش از ۳۰ نفر کشته شده‌اند.

items.title: ترامپ مشاور ارشد تروث‌سوشال را به عنوان سخنگوی کاخ سفید منصوب کرد

items.summary: بلومبرگ به نقل از مقام‌های غربی گزارش داد جمهوری اسلامی با وجود ماه‌ها حملات آمریکا و اسرائیل، توان تولید موشک و پهپاد و تجدید ذخایر تسلیحاتی خود را حفظ کرده است. کاخ سفید این ارزیابی را رد کرد و گفت زیرساخت‌های تولید تسلیحات حکومت ایران نابود شده‌اند.

items.title: احکام شلاق برای بیش از ۱۰ تن از کارگران معترض شرکت پتروپارس در استان خوزستان اجرا شد

items.title: ترامپ از توافق با پوتین برای عرضه گازوئیل روسیه خبر داد؛ زلنسکی: هدیه به پوتین است

The violence raises bigger questions about what is driving these gangs and whether struggles to fit into American life, cultural or clan ties, government policies or failures by schools and other institutions have played a role and what makes these youths different from traditional American street gangs. "They're coming from families. They got money, and they have resources," Bloomington Police Chief Booker Hodges told Fox News Digital of the young Somali American gang members under investigation. Those questions follow a late-night Bloomington gunfight that left one person injured during a string of shootings across suburban Minneapolis-St. Paul . 100-SHOT SOMALI GANG GUN BATTLE ROCKS MINNESOTA AS SHERIFF WARNS 'WE'RE IN TROUBLE' Hodges said the suspects defy traditional drug- or money-driven gang profiles. FBI INVESTIGATES AFTER SHINYHUNTERS HACKERS CLAIM THEFT OF AGENTS' PERSONAL DATA Patel said the FBI is working with its partners to dismantle the group and its associates. items.summary_original: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck off Panama's southern coast Friday, shaking the country's capital as officials investigated a potential tsunami threat. The U.S. Geological Survey initially measured the earthquake at magnitude 8.0 before lowering its estimate to 7.7. The quake struck at 1:56 p.m. ET, at a depth of 7.8 miles, near Pitaloza Arriba, Panama. A 5.5 magnitude aftershock followed, with its epicenter approximately 50 miles east of the initial earthquake. The Panama Canal said operations were continuing normally following Friday's earthquake, with emergency protocols activated and technical teams inspecting facilities for possible damage. Canal officials said their priority was ensuring the safety of workers, vessels, crews and nearby communities as assessments continued. Tsunami officials warned that waves reaching 3 to 10 feet above tide levels were possible along some coastal areas of Panama, while parts of Ecuador could experience waves of approximately 1 to 3 feet. Smaller tsunami waves of less than 1 foot above tide levels were forecast for coastal areas of Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Mexico, Nicaragua and Peru. items.summary_original: A South Carolina Democrat running for U.S. Senate who previously opposed legislation restricting transgender athletes' participation in girls' sports is now emphasizing her opposition to biological males participating in female athletics as President Donald Trump targets her record ahead of the midterm elections. Trump took aim at Annie Andrews, a pediatrician challenging Republican Sen. Darline Graham, in a series of Truth Social posts this week, dubbing her "Annie Trannie" and accusing her of supporting transgender policies that are out of step with South Carolina voters. The president also shared an attack ad accusing Andrews of supporting biological males competing against female athletes. "Annie Andrews is for they/them, not for our values, not for South Carolina," the ad said. But Andrews pushed back in an interview with Fox News Digital on Thursday, arguing that her positions have been misrepresented. "I don't support biological men playing in women's sports and I don't support gender surgery on minors," Andrews said. Her comments stand in contrast to her public opposition to South Carolina's 2022 Save Women’s Sports Act , which restricted transgender athletes' participation in girls' and women's school sports. items.summary_original: President Donald Trump has set up a committee to investigate Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook over allegations she made false statements on mortgage documents, the same accusations Trump has cited for over a year in a bid to remove her from office. Trump attempted to remove Cook in August 2025, triggering a lengthy legal battle that culminated in the Supreme Court blocking her firing in June 2026. In a 5-4 ruling, the court ruled she had not been given adequate time to respond to the allegations against her. This newly-formed committee appears to be the process the White House has settled on to give Cook a chance to advocate for herself, as she will be allowed to submit a written statement ahead of her first scheduled hearing on Nov. 5, 2026. At the hearing itself, Cook will be able to "present argument, written evidence, and written witness statements regarding the evidence and allegations," the White House said. The couple exchanged vows over the phone from inside Isfahan prison, joined by their fathers. Authorities are investigating whether the attacks are connected to an online challenge encouraging teenagers to kill as many people as possible. Police said a 37-year-old woman who worked as a caretaker died in the Thursday morning attack at the school in Leszczydol-Nowiny, northeast of Warsaw. The school's head teacher, Krzysztof Ochmanski, was injured while subduing the teenager, officials said. Ochmanski told a radio station he heard a scream and ran into a hallway. "By then, I had managed to restrain him." The day before the latest attack, a 19-year-old allegedly wounded 10 people, including himself, at a school in Ostroleka, which is in northeastern Poland. Also this week, police arrested a 17-year-old in Sierpc in north-central Poland after authorities suspected he was planning a similar attack, Reuters reported. You have a nation going through unspeakable pain, not only because of Oct. 7, but also because of the feeling that they are alone and that the world has turned against them," Evans added. "What I’m sharing on Oct. 7 is this: ‘You’re wrong. The world is standing with you,’" he continued. "You see the faces, languages and songs of people from around the world united to comfort you and stand with you. It’s not political. It’s for the Jewish people: You are not alone. We’re with you. "They didn't let me change clothes or to get a shower, even to eat or to drink," he said. "They chained me with heavy iron chains by my leg," Cohen said during an emotional discussion moderated by Dr. Phil McGraw at Israel’s U.N. commemoration Tuesday. He said lights were kept on to prevent the hostages from sleeping and that captors would enter repeatedly during the night screaming in an effort to frighten them. Cohen said they were not permitted to use a restroom and that at times survival felt almost impossible. "Don't think about the violence. Don't think about the torture. Don't think about everything," Cohen recalled telling himself. "Just continue, stay strong. And maybe one day, you will come back home to your family."
